title: When a message travels
goal: Transmitir información conservando quién dijo qué y qué sigue vigente.
strategy: Antes de transformar los verbos, identificá hablante, destinatario y momento. El discurso indirecto también exige ajustar pronombres y referencias como tomorrow.
passage: On Monday, the course coordinator told the class, “The workshop will start at ten tomorrow. Bring a short text you would like to discuss.” Later that day, Elena sent a message to an absent classmate. She explained that the workshop would start at ten the following day and said that participants should bring a short text. Her classmate asked whether the workshop was open to beginners. Elena did not guess. She contacted the coordinator, who confirmed that it was. In a second message, Elena added, “The coordinator says beginners are welcome.” The present tense was useful because the information was still current.
questions: Why did Elena contact the coordinator?
To check information she did not know
El texto destaca que no inventó la respuesta sobre principiantes.
Which is a correct reported question?
She asked whether was the workshop open.
She asked whether the workshop was open.
She asked that was it open.
En una pregunta indirecta se usa el orden sujeto + verbo, sin inversión interrogativa.
task: Transmití por escrito el anuncio de un evento a alguien ausente. Incluí una afirmación, una instrucción y una pregunta indirecta. Distinguí lo confirmado de lo que todavía debés averiguar.
model: The organiser told us that the discussion would begin at six on Friday. She asked us to read the short article before attending. Mateo asked whether we needed to prepare a presentation, and she said that this was not necessary. I also wanted to know if the room had step-free access. The organiser said she would check, so I cannot confirm that detail yet. Her latest message says that visitors are welcome, which is still the current arrangement.
checklist: Usé tell con un destinatario cuando correspondía.
En la pregunta indirecta mantuve sujeto antes del verbo.
No transformé automáticamente información actual en algo que parece vencido.
contrast: She asked where was the room.
She asked where the room was.
La interrogativa indirecta no usa el orden invertido de la pregunta directa.
